name: frosted_ice_melt_chain_reaction
description: Everything is sealed in stone, so there is no light and frosted ice never ages or melts on its own. Flint places blocks with /setblock and /fill, which notify neighbours with the new block (ServerLevel.updateNeighboursOnBlockSet), while a melting block notifies its neighbours with the old block, frosted ice. Filling a straight line of five frosted ice blocks at once notifies every block with frosted ice. The two ends have only 1 frosted neighbour and melt. Each melt notifies the next block in the line, which by then has only 1 frosted neighbour, so the melting runs along the whole line in the same tick, even through the middle blocks that had 2 neighbours when they were placed.
